name: The Talk
description: A panel of well-known news and entertainment personalities discussing current events, pop culture, contemporary issues, family, celebrity and the trending topics of the day.

videos.title: Christie Brinkley (Series Premiere)
videos.overview: Christie Brinkley is the show's first guest, and what age is best to talk to your kids about sex?

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: The girls talk about Taylor Swift, and what they think about the rumors that she wrote a song about John Mayer, Jennifer Lopez talks about American Idol, and uses her new skills to judge the girls red carpet outfits, and the Dog with the record for World's Longest Tongue also stops by.

videos.title: Jenny Sanford & Melissa Rycroft
videos.overview: The show talks to Jenny Sanford about her husband's affair, and how she's doing now. Also Melissa Rycroft stops by, and the girls try to guess the sex of her baby.

videos.title: Chandra Wilson
videos.overview: The girls play doctor with Grey's Anatomy star Chandra Wilson. Leah, Julie, and Sharon talk about toddler pole dancing with moms and a dance instructor.

videos.title: Jamie Lee Curtis & Rick Fox
videos.overview: Jamie Lee Curtis does her first television interview since the death of her father, and what she thought of him may surprise you. Also Dancing With The Stars's Rick Fox stops by and reveals his plans to take down Jennifer Grey, and Marissa finds out what people think about children on airplanes.

videos.title: Judge Judy & Jack Hanna
videos.overview: The girls talk about Brett Favre, and his situation. Judge Judy talks about renting drug sniffing dogs to find out if your kids are doing drugs, and parents getting arrested for not going to parent/teacher conferences. Jack Hanna brings the crazy to the show, and Julie rides a camel.

videos.title: Michael Weatherly
videos.overview: NCIS's Michael Weatherly comes for a visit and talks about meeting his wife, and his son. Also, the panel talks about bullying. They spoke to a girl who got cyber-bullied, and a young boy who got beat up for being a cheerleader. They also speak to a bully to see what makes them what they are, and the girls share their own personal bullying stories.

videos.title: Hilary Swank
videos.overview: Hilary Swank talks about her new movie, and the woman the movie is based on. Also, Julie tells her bullying story, and The Talks's Mom on the Street, Marrisa, talks to people about how people deal with 2 year olds.
